sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Neelam Singh,Preet Pal Singh Rathore
Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.
1.

The petitioners, by means of this writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, has invoked the jurisdiction of this Court with prayer to quash the impugned First Information Report dated 3.10.2023 registered as Case Crime No.206 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 354,
377, 406 IPC and 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Kydganj, District City Commissionerate Prayagraj,
and for a direction to the respondents not to arrest the petitioners in pursuance of impugned First Information Report.
Kismatun Nisha And 7 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110247563/
1 2.

entities.text: Kismatun Nisha And 7 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The matter was entertained by the coordinate Bench on 28.11.2023 and the same was referred to the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this Court as learned counsel for both the parties submitted that the matter may be amicably settled by way of mediation and conciliation.

3. Today, when the matter is taken up, learned counsel for the petitioners fairly states that in response to the aforesaid order, petitioners have not deposited the requisite amount before the mediation centre and as such, he is not inclined to press the writ petition and the same may be dismissed as not pressed.
4. Consequently, the writ petition is dismissed as not pressed in terms of the aforesaid.
5. This order has been passed with due assistance of Sri Preet Pal Singh Rathore, learned counsel for the contesting-respondent.
